title: Kun The Receptive
reflection: Let things come to you. The earth does not grasp, yet it holds everything.
career: Support the team and strengthen the foundation before seeking recognition.
love: Offer steadiness without controlling the other person; care grows through reliable presence.
outlook: Slow, steady, and quietly favorable.
money: Preserve reserves and build slowly; dependable support is more valuable than a quick gain.
well_being: Choose regular sleep, nourishment, and a slower rhythm that allows the body to recover.
family: Support the household quietly and let dependable care create security.
personal_growth: Practice receiving help and allowing progress without controlling every outcome.
caution: Do not mistake receptivity for passivity or allow support to become self-erasure.

title: Bo Splitting Apart
reflection: Release what is already falling away. What decays makes room for what is coming.
career: End an unproductive assignment cleanly so resources can move elsewhere.
love: Allow an ending to be real instead of holding a relationship together through fear.
outlook: Let the decline finish. The opening comes afterward.
money: Stop funding what is already failing and recover what can still be saved.
well_being: Release the habit or demand that is already draining vitality.
family: Allow an outdated family role or expectation to end without blame.
personal_growth: Release an identity or habit that has already completed its purpose.
caution: Don't repair what has already lost its foundation.

title: Bi Holding Together
reflection: Seek the company that steadies you. Union begins with a single shared direction.
career: Build alliances around one objective and make responsibilities explicit.
love: Choose relationships with shared values, not merely shared loneliness.
outlook: A qualified yes, provided everyone pulls in one direction.
money: Shared resources can grow when ownership, contribution, and distribution are agreed clearly.
well_being: Supportive company and shared routines can improve emotional steadiness.
family: Strengthen family unity around one shared priority and clear responsibilities.
personal_growth: Learn how commitment to a shared purpose can strengthen your own character.
caution: Avoid alliances based only on convenience or fear of standing alone.

title: Guan Contemplation
reflection: Step back and watch without rushing to act. Clarity arrives when you stop interfering.
career: Delay intervention until observation reveals the real pattern.
love: Watch the pattern of actions before deciding what words mean.
outlook: Too early to call. Step back and watch.
money: Gather information before spending. The hidden cost is more important than the advertised price.
well_being: Reduce stimulation and observe what your body and mood are communicating.
family: Observe the family pattern before stepping in to correct it.
personal_growth: Develop the discipline to observe without immediately judging or acting.
caution: Observation can become avoidance if you never decide.

title: Yu Enthusiasm
reflection: Let quiet joy set your pace. When the heart is light, momentum finds you.
career: Use enthusiasm to mobilize others, but give the energy a practical plan.
love: Let joy create movement, but do not promise more than the bond can hold.
outlook: Momentum is building. Give it a plan.
money: A promising opportunity needs a budget before enthusiasm becomes expense.
well_being: Use rising energy constructively, but protect recovery time.
family: A positive shared activity can renew warmth if expectations remain realistic.
personal_growth: Turn inspiration into a repeatable practice rather than chasing a mood.
caution: Excitement without preparation scatters energy and creates disappointment.

title: Jin Progress
reflection: Rise like the sun, unhurried and certain. Steady light outlasts the sudden flare.
career: Present completed work confidently; consistent visibility brings advancement.
love: A relationship can progress when appreciation is expressed consistently and openly.
outlook: Favorable. Recognition comes through consistency, not spectacle.
money: Income prospects improve through visible, consistent work rather than speculation.
well_being: A steady daily rhythm supports confidence better than bursts of overexertion.
family: Consistent encouragement helps a family member move forward with confidence.
personal_growth: Build confidence by making steady progress visible to yourself.
caution: Do not confuse visibility with lasting progress.

title: Cui Gathering Together
reflection: Call what belongs together into one place. Strength is multiplied in company.
career: Bring the right people together and define why their cooperation matters.
love: Bring people together around belonging, while protecting the intimacy of the closest bond.
outlook: People and resources are moving together. Choose the center carefully.
money: Pooling resources may help, but keep a trusted center of financial responsibility.
well_being: Community is restorative when you can participate without losing privacy.
family: Bring relatives together around a sincere purpose, not obligation alone.
personal_growth: Learn to gather your scattered motives around one honest intention.
caution: A gathering without a sincere center becomes a crowd competing for influence.

title: Pi Standstill
reflection: When the paths are blocked, conserve your strength. Stillness now is preparation, not defeat.
career: Protect time and resources while external conditions remain blocked.
love: If connection is blocked, conserve dignity and wait rather than chase reassurance.
outlook: Blocked for now. Waiting protects more than pushing.
money: Delay expansion and protect liquidity while access remains restricted.
well_being: Conserve energy and avoid forcing performance during a blocked period.
family: Protect the household’s energy and resources while outside conditions remain difficult.
personal_growth: Develop the wisdom to conserve strength instead of proving endurance.
caution: Do not exhaust yourself fighting conditions that cannot yet move.

title: Qian Modesty
reflection: Achieve much and speak of it little. The mountain hides its height in the plain.
career: Let results speak before status; modest leadership earns durable trust.
love: Humility and attentive listening make affection safer for both people.
outlook: Good prospects, with little need to advertise them.
money: Quiet accumulation is favored; avoid spending to display success.
well_being: Quiet confidence and modest expectations reduce unnecessary stress.
family: Lead with humility; family respect grows when everyone has room to contribute.
personal_growth: Let humility become accurate self-knowledge rather than self-denial.
caution: Humility should not become silence in the face of unfairness.

title: Gen Keeping Still
reflection: Come to a full stop. Stillness is not emptiness; it is the ground beneath all motion.
career: Pause expansion, establish limits, and finish what is already underway.
love: Respect a need for silence or space; stillness is not automatically rejection.
outlook: A useful pause. Nothing is lost by waiting.
money: Freeze unnecessary commitments and review recurring costs.
well_being: Rest, stillness, and firm boundaries are restorative now.
family: Honor a need for quiet, privacy, or firmer boundaries at home.
personal_growth: Discover what becomes clear when you stop, listen, and hold a boundary.
caution: Stillness becomes stagnation when the needed boundary has already been understood.

title: Jian Obstruction
reflection: The way is obstructed. Pause, change direction, and seek the help that allows movement to resume.
career: Change route, seek expert help, or renegotiate the obstacle instead of forcing it.
love: Name the obstacle together and ask whether help or a different route is needed.
outlook: Not by the present route. Help or a change of direction improves the odds.
money: Do not put more money into an obstructed plan until the route changes.
well_being: Change the routine or seek qualified support rather than pushing through persistent strain.
family: Seek help or change the arrangement rather than repeating the same family conflict.
personal_growth: Learn to change direction without interpreting it as failure.
caution: Persistence is not a virtue when the route itself is wrong.

title: Jian Development
reflection: Small, patient steps shape the slope. What grows gradually cannot be rushed.
career: Choose a long project and improve it through steady, measurable stages.
love: Let trust develop through repeated actions instead of demanding immediate certainty.
outlook: Yes, but slowly. Repetition matters more than speed.
money: Regular contributions and patient compounding are more favorable than a dramatic bet.
well_being: Gentle, consistent practice brings more benefit than an extreme program.
family: A slow improvement in family trust is more durable than a dramatic reconciliation.
personal_growth: Accept that meaningful development cannot be rushed.
caution: Do not force gradual growth into an artificial deadline.

title: Xiao Guo Preponderance Of The Small
reflection: Favor the modest over the grand. A small correction prevents a large collapse.
career: Correct small defects now; precision prevents an expensive failure later.
love: Attend to the small hurt before it becomes the story of the relationship.
outlook: A small correction works; a grand gesture does not.
money: Correct small leaks in the budget before pursuing larger returns.
well_being: Attend to a small symptom of stress before it becomes a larger pattern.
family: Address the small household problem before it becomes a lasting grievance.
personal_growth: Train attention on small corrections before seeking dramatic transformation.
caution: Avoid magnifying a small matter after the necessary correction is made.

title: Lü The Wanderer
reflection: Travel light and treat each place with respect. The stranger who is courteous finds welcome.
career: Adapt quickly to a temporary role while respecting local expectations.
love: In a temporary or distant connection, be courteous without pretending permanence.
outlook: Temporary and unsettled. Stay light on your feet.
money: Keep travel or temporary living costs flexible and avoid long obligations.
well_being: Keep travel, sleep, food, and movement simple while conditions are unsettled.
family: During travel, relocation, or change, keep familiar rituals that preserve belonging.
personal_growth: Grow through adaptability while keeping an inner sense of home.
caution: Do not demand permanent security from a temporary situation.

title: Xian Influence
reflection: True influence is silent and mutual. Approach without force and the other draws near.
career: Influence through listening and reciprocity rather than authority alone.
love: Attraction is healthiest when influence moves in both directions.
outlook: Possible, if the response is genuinely mutual.
money: A partnership can benefit both sides if value and risk move reciprocally.
well_being: Emotional balance improves through mutual, calm contact rather than intensity.
family: Mutual influence works best when older and younger voices are both heard.
personal_growth: Notice how your presence affects others and whether the influence is mutual.
caution: Attraction can become coercion when reciprocity disappears.

title: Dun Retreat
reflection: Know when to step back. The wise retreat is chosen, not forced.
career: Withdraw from a losing position early enough to preserve future options.
love: Step back from a destructive cycle before resentment makes return impossible.
outlook: Step back now. A later return will be stronger.
money: Exit a deteriorating financial position before losses remove future choices.
well_being: Step away from the cycle that repeatedly exhausts or agitates you.
family: Step back from a family dispute before anger makes repair harder.
personal_growth: Learn that a chosen retreat can preserve dignity and future freedom.
caution: Retreat should preserve purpose, not become habitual avoidance.

title: Shi The Army
reflection: Move as one. Order, not noise, wins the long field.
career: Clarify command, standards, and roles before asking for greater effort.
love: Shared rules and responsibilities can protect love during a demanding period.
outlook: Order can return under capable leadership.
money: Create firm controls, documented authority, and a realistic operating budget.
well_being: Structure the day so effort, rest, and responsibility remain proportionate.
family: Clear roles and fair duties help the household function under pressure.
personal_growth: Develop self-command before trying to direct other people.
caution: Discipline without justice turns order into fear.

title: Meng Youthful Folly
reflection: Approach uncertainty with sincerity. Receive the first answer fully before asking the oracle again.
career: Learn the system, accept instruction, and do not hide uncertainty behind confidence.
love: Ask sincerely, listen once, and avoid testing the relationship with repeated questions.
outlook: Confusion clears once you stop asking the same question.
money: Learn the financial terms fully before signing or investing.
well_being: Admit what you do not understand and seek reliable guidance instead of self-diagnosing.
family: Teach patiently and avoid shaming someone who is still learning.
personal_growth: Remain teachable and receive an answer before demanding another one.
caution: Repeated questioning can become refusal to hear the first answer.

title: Kan The Abysmal
reflection: Face the deep water and keep walking. What repeats is meant to teach you.
career: Prepare for recurring pressure with reliable procedures and calm execution.
love: Consistency matters more than dramatic reassurance when emotions run deep.
outlook: Difficult, but passable with preparation.
money: Maintain an emergency reserve. Recurring risk requires preparation.
well_being: Recurring stress calls for preparation, pacing, and professional help when needed.
family: A recurring family stress needs preparation, consistency, and outside support if necessary.
personal_growth: Build courage through practiced responses to recurring difficulty.
caution: Do not normalize danger merely because it has become familiar.

title: Huan Dispersion
reflection: Dissolve the barrier, then gather again around what is essential.
career: Resolve factional tension by restoring a shared purpose.
love: Dissolve old grievances around a renewed commitment, not around denial.
outlook: The separation can be healed. Rebuild around what still matters.
money: Consolidate scattered accounts or debts around one manageable plan.
well_being: Release accumulated tension through movement, breath, conversation, or a change of environment.
family: Dissolve old divisions by returning to what the family still shares.
personal_growth: Release the inner division that keeps energy scattered.
caution: Dispersion without a new center leaves people more divided than before.

title: Xie Deliverance
reflection: The ice has broken. Move now, while the way is open.
career: Act when the blockage releases; the window may not remain open for long.
love: When tension breaks, speak plainly and use the opening to reconnect.
outlook: The opening is real. Move before it closes.
money: A released payment or opportunity may arrive; use it to restore balance before spending freely.
well_being: Use the easing period to restore sleep and rebuild depleted routines.
family: Use a moment of relief to reconnect and restore ordinary cooperation.
personal_growth: Recognize the moment when tension has broken and movement is possible.
caution: Relief can invite haste; confirm that the opening is real.

title: Wei Ji Before Completion
reflection: The work is not finished, and that is its life. Stay with it to the last stroke.
career: Treat the project as unfinished until the final checks are complete.
love: A transition is not complete; confirm expectations before declaring the issue resolved.
outlook: Nearly there, which is exactly why care matters now.
money: Hold back a final portion until every obligation and fee is confirmed.
well_being: Do not stop care or recovery practices simply because you feel temporarily better.
family: Do not declare a family issue solved until the final responsibility is settled.
personal_growth: Strengthen follow-through. The last portion of a task reveals character.
caution: Near-completion is when carelessness is most costly.

title: Kun Oppression
reflection: Even in the tightest pass, there is a breath. Find it, and the wall loosens.
career: Preserve professional integrity during scarcity, fatigue, or weak morale.
love: During emotional exhaustion, protect kindness and do not make permanent decisions from despair.
outlook: The pressure continues. Hold to the one thing you cannot afford to lose.
money: Reduce discretionary spending and protect essentials during the constrained period.
well_being: Protect the inner sense of purpose when fatigue or low morale persists.
family: Protect kindness when the household is tired, worried, or under financial pressure.
personal_growth: Preserve meaning and integrity during periods of frustration or scarcity.
caution: Do not let hardship convince you that integrity no longer matters.

title: Song Conflict
reflection: Not every dispute deserves your victory. Sometimes the truce is the win.
career: Seek mediation and a workable settlement before conflict consumes the objective.
love: Do not pursue victory over the person you hope to remain close to.
outlook: Poor if the fight continues; better if the aim is narrowed.
money: Legal or interpersonal disputes can become expensive; settlement may preserve more value than victory.
well_being: Conflict is taxing the system; reduce exposure and choose de- escalation where possible.
family: Choose mediation and limits instead of turning the home into a courtroom.
personal_growth: Learn to limit conflict before the need to be right consumes perspective.
caution: Winning the argument may destroy the relationship or objective.

title: Sheng Pushing Upward
reflection: Grow upward without forcing the stem. The tree that bends in wind stands longest.
career: Advance without forcing promotion. Credibility grows through useful contribution.
love: Allow the relationship to grow upward at its natural pace.
outlook: Favorable growth, provided it is not forced.
money: Income can rise gradually through steady effort rather than leverage.
well_being: Let strength return gradually and avoid comparing your pace with others.
family: Let family bonds grow through dependable presence rather than control.
personal_growth: Grow without forcing the pace or comparing your path with someone else’s.
caution: Growth becomes brittle when it is driven by force.

title: Gu Work On The Decayed
reflection: Tend what was neglected before it fails. Renewal begins with honest accounting.
career: Audit inherited problems honestly and repair causes rather than appearances.
love: Repair the inherited habit or recurring wound instead of blaming the latest trigger.
outlook: Repair first. Renewal follows.
money: Pay for necessary repair now instead of allowing hidden damage to compound.
well_being: Repair the neglected cause of imbalance instead of masking the latest discomfort.
family: Repair the inherited pattern instead of passing it to the next generation.
personal_growth: Repair the inherited belief or habit that continues to shape present choices.
caution: Don't hide inherited damage beneath cosmetic repair.

title: Jing The Well
reflection: Dig deep and share the water. What truly nourishes asks nothing in return.
career: Protect shared knowledge, tools, and resources from private capture.
love: Nourish the bond through shared routines, honest speech, and care for ordinary needs.
outlook: The source is sound, but someone must maintain it.
money: Protect shared assets and keep access fair, documented, and maintained.
well_being: Nourishment, hydration, speech, and attention all deserve balanced care.
family: Shared meals, honest speech, and ordinary care strengthen the family center.
personal_growth: Study what your words, attention, and appetites are nourishing.
caution: A shared resource fails when no one accepts responsibility for its care.

title: Xun The Gentle
reflection: The wind wears the stone by returning, not by striking. Persist gently.
career: Use repeated, tactful communication to shift resistance gradually.
love: Gentle influence, repeated over time, works better than pressure.
outlook: Little changes are taking hold. Expect a delayed result.
money: Small, repeated savings or improvements will matter more than one large gesture.
well_being: Small calming practices repeated daily can shift the whole emotional climate.
family: Gentle repetition changes family habits more effectively than criticism.
personal_growth: Trust the power of small actions repeated with gentle intention.
caution: Gentleness should not become indirectness or concealed pressure.

title: Heng Duration
reflection: What endures is not the loud but the constant. Keep the rhythm and time bends to you.
career: Maintain the core mission while adapting methods to new conditions.
love: Keep commitments steady while allowing the form of the relationship to evolve.
outlook: Built to last, if the method can change.
money: Choose a durable financial plan that can survive changing conditions.
well_being: A stable routine helps, but it must remain flexible enough for changing needs.
family: Preserve the family’s core values while allowing roles to evolve.
personal_growth: Discover the difference between constancy and rigidity.
caution: Constancy is not the same as refusing necessary change.

title: Ding The Cauldron
reflection: Prepare the meal with care. What is offered from the center feeds many.
career: Transform neglected resources into something that can nourish the wider group.
love: Create warmth and nourishment, but do not make one person responsible for everyone.
outlook: A genuine renewal is possible. Share what has been restored.
money: Renew or repurpose an underused asset before buying something new.
well_being: Warmth, food, creativity, and shared care can renew depleted energy.
family: Renew the household through nourishment, warmth, and shared responsibility.
personal_growth: Transform what you have learned into something that can nourish others.
caution: Transformation fails when nourishment is hoarded at the center.

title: Da Guo Preponderance Of The Great
reflection: When the load is extraordinary, the ordinary rule no longer fits. Shoulder it with care.
career: Accept an exceptional burden only with support, time, and authority to carry it.
love: An unusual burden needs explicit consent and shared support.
outlook: Possible, but not alone. The load needs support.
money: An exceptional expense requires contingency, support, and clear limits.
well_being: An exceptional burden requires more rest and assistance than usual.
family: An exceptional family burden must be acknowledged and distributed fairly.
personal_growth: Accept unusual responsibility without pretending you need no support.
caution: Do not carry an extraordinary burden as if it were ordinary.

title: Gou Coming To Meet
reflection: A strong new influence approaches. Meet it awake, and establish the boundary it requires.
career: Treat an attractive new offer cautiously until its influence and obligations are clear.
love: A powerful attraction requires boundaries before it becomes entanglement.
outlook: This influence will grow quickly. Set the boundary now.
money: Treat a tempting offer as high-risk until every obligation is understood.
well_being: Strong attraction or stimulation can overwhelm balance; establish limits early.
family: Set an early boundary around a disruptive relative or new influence.
personal_growth: Strengthen discernment when a powerful attraction or opportunity appears.
caution: Don't welcome a powerful influence before understanding its cost.

title: Fu Return
reflection: The turning point comes quietly. One step back to the root restores the whole.
career: Return to the sound practice that was abandoned; one correction restores direction.
love: Return to the honest center of the relationship with one uncomplicated gesture.
outlook: A quiet turn for the better. One right step is enough.
money: Return to a simple budget or proven source of income.
well_being: Return to the simple practice that previously restored stability.
family: Return to one simple family practice that previously created closeness.
personal_growth: Return to your center through one simple, correct action.
caution: A return loses meaning if the same neglected cause remains untouched.

title: Yi Nourishment
reflection: Attend to what truly sustains you. Guard the mouth and the mind alike.
career: Review what the organization consumes, rewards, and communicates.
love: Notice what your attention, words, and habits are feeding between you.
outlook: The outcome is being fed by today’s habits.
money: Review consumption habits; what you repeatedly buy is shaping the future balance.
well_being: Notice what you consume physically, emotionally, and digitally.
family: Notice what habits, speech, and attention are being fed in the home.
personal_growth: Become more selective about what you consume and repeat.
caution: Guard against consuming more attention, approval, or comfort than you can digest.

title: Zhun Difficulty At The Beginning
reflection: Every great thing starts in chaos. Take the first step and the path appears.
career: Create order at the beginning: assign priorities before accelerating activity.
love: A new relationship needs structure and patience before intensity.
outlook: A hard beginning with real promise.
money: New ventures need staged funding and firm priorities.
well_being: At a difficult beginning, prioritize basic routines before ambitious improvement.
family: A new household phase needs structure, patience, and realistic expectations.
personal_growth: Create structure before asking motivation to carry the whole journey.
caution: Chaos at the beginning worsens when action outruns structure.

title: Yi Increase
reflection: Give a little and receive more. Increase flows to the open hand.
career: Invest where value circulates; generous support can produce reciprocal growth.
love: Generosity strengthens love when it is freely given and mutually respected.
outlook: Increase is likely where giving and purpose meet.
money: Generosity can circulate value, but give from capacity rather than pressure.
well_being: Energy increases when giving and receiving remain balanced.
family: Generosity strengthens family life when it does not create dependence.
personal_growth: Let generosity expand capacity without turning into self- sacrifice.
caution: Increase gained through exploitation will not remain favorable.

title: Zhen The Arousing
reflection: The thunder shakes what slept. Meet the shock and move; do not freeze.
career: Use disruption to identify the weak system that routine concealed.
love: A sudden event reveals what each person relies on; respond after the first shock passes.
outlook: A jolt changes the pace. Respond after the first shock passes.
money: A sudden cost may expose weak preparation; preserve cash until the shock is understood.
well_being: After a shock, settle the nervous system before making major changes.
family: After a sudden event, stabilize the household before making permanent changes.
personal_growth: Use surprise as a teacher that reveals hidden dependence or fear.
caution: Do not make irreversible decisions during the first shock.

title: Shi He Biting Through
reflection: When the way is blocked in the mouth, bite through. A clear judgement frees the tongue.
career: State the decision openly, remove the obstruction, and avoid humiliating opponents.
love: Say what must end without cruelty, threats, or public humiliation.
outlook: Yes—if the break is clean and not vindictive.
money: Cut the confirmed loss decisively, but do not sell or spend in anger.
well_being: Remove the confirmed source of harm without turning the process into self-punishment.
family: End the harmful behavior clearly without humiliating the person involved.
personal_growth: Practice decisive action without hatred or self-punishment.
caution: Decisiveness becomes destructive when anger chooses the target.

title: Sui Following
reflection: Move with the tide that is right. To follow wisely is its own form of leading.
career: Follow proven leadership only while judgment and ethics remain intact.
love: Follow the relationship’s natural rhythm without surrendering independent judgment.
outlook: The path opens when sound guidance is followed without surrendering judgment.
money: Continue a sound financial plan while checking that the assumptions still hold.
well_being: Follow a sustainable rhythm and keep checking whether it still serves you.
family: Follow healthy family traditions while questioning customs that no longer serve.
personal_growth: Follow what is sound while keeping your own ethical judgment awake.
caution: Following becomes dangerous when judgment is surrendered.

title: Wu Wang Innocence
reflection: Act without hidden motive. The unforeseen favors the unguarded heart.
career: Work from clear principle rather than image management or hidden calculation.
love: Act without manipulation; affection offered for advantage cannot remain innocent.
outlook: Unexpectedly favorable, provided the motive stays clean.
money: Clean money and transparent motives reduce future complications.
well_being: Act from clean intention, but remain attentive to practical consequences.
family: Act from honest care rather than guilt, image, or hidden bargaining.
personal_growth: Align action with clean motives while remaining aware of consequences.
caution: Innocence is not naivety. Verify consequences even when motives are pure.

title: Ming Yi Darkening Of The Light
reflection: When the light is dimmed, do not announce yourself. Preserve the inner flame in silence.
career: Protect sensitive work and avoid announcing plans before conditions are safe.
love: Protect the bond quietly during a difficult public or family situation.
outlook: Unfavorable for public action. Protect what matters in private.
money: Keep assets and plans discreet during an unfavorable or uncertain period.
well_being: Protect rest and emotional privacy during a difficult external period.
family: Protect vulnerable family matters from unnecessary public exposure.
personal_growth: Learn how to protect the inner light without seeking validation.
caution: Don't expose what still requires protection.

title: Bi Grace
reflection: Beauty is the polish on truth. Let form serve the substance, never hide it.
career: Improve presentation only after the substance is sound.
love: Beauty and romance help, but they cannot substitute for truth.
outlook: It looks better than it is. Test the substance.
money: Do not pay a premium for appearance when the underlying value is weak.
well_being: Pleasure and beauty can support well-being when they do not conceal the underlying issue.
family: Celebration and beauty can restore warmth, but they cannot conceal unresolved truth.
personal_growth: Let beauty express truth instead of compensating for insecurity.
caution: Adornment becomes deception when it replaces substance.

title: Ji Ji After Completion
reflection: The crossing is made; now keep it made. Success unguarded becomes its own danger.
career: After success, strengthen controls; completion is when complacency becomes dangerous.
love: After reconciliation, maintain the practices that made repair possible.
outlook: Success is present but fragile. Maintain it.
money: After reaching a target, secure the gain and maintain the system that produced it.
well_being: Maintain the habits that created recovery; feeling better is not the same as being finished.
family: After a family milestone, maintain the routines that keep the household stable.
personal_growth: Develop the humility to maintain success after the exciting work is finished.
caution: Do not assume a completed agreement will maintain itself.

title: Jia Ren The Family
reflection: Order the smallest circle first. The household in harmony needs no command.
career: Repair order in the closest working relationships before scaling outward.
love: Household harmony depends on clear roles, fair labor, and mutual respect.
outlook: Stability begins close to home.
money: Household finances improve through clear roles, shared visibility, and fair contribution.
well_being: Household order and fair distribution of labor reduce chronic strain.
family: Tend Order the smallest circle first. The household in harmony needs no command. CAREER Repair order in the closest working relationships before scaling outward. LOVE Household harmony depends on clear roles, fair labor, and mutual respect. OUTLOOK Stability begins close to home. MONEY Household finances improve through clear roles, shared visibility, and fair contribution. WELL-BEING Household order and fair distribution of labor reduce chronic strain. FAMILY Harmony depends on fair labor, clear authority, and respect for each person.
personal_growth: Begin personal order with the relationships and duties nearest to you.
caution: Order in the home should not justify domination or fixed inequality.

title: Feng Abundance
reflection: Your light is full, share it widely. Abundance unused dims to regret.
career: Share abundance, reduce excess, and prepare before the peak begins to pass.
love: Enjoy a period of fullness while remaining attentive to what has been neglected.
outlook: Abundant now, leaner later. Use the fullness well.
money: Use abundance to reduce debt, strengthen reserves, and prepare for a leaner phase.
well_being: Enjoy high energy without exhausting tomorrow’s reserves.
family: Share abundance across the household and prepare together for future change.
personal_growth: Learn to enjoy abundance without losing foresight or gratitude.
caution: Abundance breeds regret when excess is neither shared nor managed.

title: Li The Clinging
reflection: Attach to what gives light. Clarity comes from staying close to the source.
career: Stay connected to the source of clarity: evidence, purpose, and competent people.
love: Stay close to what gives the relationship clarity rather than feeding distraction.
outlook: Clarity is returning. Stay with the source, not the noise.
money: Stay attached to the source of value rather than chasing fashionable alternatives.
well_being: Stay close to the activity, person, or environment that genuinely restores clarity.
family: Stay close to the family member or practice that restores clarity and connection.
personal_growth: Identify the source that restores clarity and stay consciously connected to it.
caution: Attachment to one source can become dependence; preserve discernment.

title: Ge Revolution
reflection: The old skin must shed. Change the form to free what was always there.
career: Change the structure only after the old form has clearly failed.
love: Real change requires releasing the old pattern, not simply renaming it.
outlook: Change is due. Timing and legitimacy decide whether it lasts.
money: A major restructuring may be justified, but budget the transition and verify the timing.
well_being: A healthier phase may require changing the structure that keeps recreating stress.
family: A lasting family improvement may require changing the structure, not just the mood.
personal_growth: Allow a genuine transformation to replace the form that no longer serves.
caution: Change for its own sake merely replaces one unstable form with another.

title: Tong Ren Fellowship With Men
reflection: Stand with others under the same sky. Common purpose dissolves the wall.
career: Build cooperation across roles through transparent rules and common purpose.
love: Shared purpose can unite two people without erasing their individuality.
outlook: Good prospects for cooperation without forced agreement.
money: Collective investment works best when purpose, governance, and exit terms are transparent.
well_being: Belonging and shared purpose support well-being when individuality remains respected.
family: Common purpose can unite relatives without demanding that everyone become alike.
personal_growth: Build fellowship without surrendering individuality.
caution: Common purpose should not erase legitimate difference.

title: Lin Approach
reflection: Step nearer with good intent. Influence grows as you draw close.
career: Greater influence brings greater responsibility; approach new authority carefully.
love: Approach with warmth and responsibility; increased influence should not become possession.
outlook: The opportunity is approaching. So is the responsibility.
money: A growing opportunity brings obligations; calculate the carrying cost before approaching further.
well_being: Approach improvement gradually and accept the responsibility that comes with greater capacity.
family: Approach a changing family role with warmth and responsibility.
personal_growth: Accept that greater influence requires greater responsibility.
caution: Approach without overpromising or using influence carelessly.

title: Sun Decrease
reflection: Give something up to gain what matters. Reduction, rightly chosen, is gain.
career: Reduce scope, expense, or ego so the essential work can recover.
love: Let go of one demand so the relationship can regain proportion.
outlook: Less brings relief. Cut the excess, not the essential.
money: Reduce nonessential expenses so the core remains healthy.
well_being: Reduce commitments so sleep, movement, food, and quiet have room again.
family: Reduce one demand or expense so the household can regain balance.
personal_growth: Discover what becomes possible when excess is deliberately reduced.
caution: Reduction becomes harmful when essentials are cut before excess.

title: Jie Limitation
reflection: Set the banks before the river runs. Limits protect the flow they contain.
career: Set limits that protect quality and energy without choking initiative.
love: Healthy limits create trust when they are explained and applied fairly.
outlook: Favorable within clear limits. Too much restriction reverses the benefit.
money: Set spending and risk limits that protect freedom rather than punish ordinary needs.
well_being: Healthy limits protect energy; rigid self-control can create a new form of strain.
family: Healthy household limits should protect everyone without becoming rigid control.
personal_growth: Create limits that protect energy while leaving room for life.
caution: A limit that cannot adapt eventually defeats its own purpose.

title: Zhong Fu Inner Truth
reflection: true Truth held at the center needs no proof. Sincerity alone moves the doubtful.
career: Let sincere commitments and accurate information carry more weight than performance.
love: Sincerity must become action; unspoken truth cannot sustain intimacy indefinitely.
outlook: Trust improves the outlook more than strategy does.
money: Trustworthy information is the most valuable asset; verify claims before moving funds.
well_being: Honest acknowledgment of feelings reduces the effort of maintaining appearances.
family: Truth spoken with care can restore family trust more effectively than appearances.
personal_growth: Practice sincerity that becomes conduct rather than performance.
caution: Sincerity without discretion can become careless exposure.

title: Gui Mei The Marrying Maiden
reflection: Enter no bond blindly. Examine the position, timing, and balance of obligation before you commit.
career: Examine rank, contract, and bargaining power before accepting the position.
love: Do not enter an unequal commitment while hoping love will later correct the imbalance.
outlook: Proceed cautiously. The imbalance is not imaginary.
money: Do not accept an unequal financial arrangement in the hope that goodwill will correct it.
well_being: An unequal bond or obligation may be affecting emotional safety; examine it clearly.
family: Examine whether a family obligation is unequal before accepting it as permanent.
personal_growth: Recognize where you are accepting an unequal role and why.
caution: Don't romanticize an unequal position or assume sacrifice guarantees security.

title: Kui Opposition
reflection: What seems opposed may simply be apart. Seek the thread that joins the two.
career: Use difference to create complementary roles rather than forced uniformity.
love: Difference need not become opposition. Find the thread both people can honor.
outlook: Difference can become useful rather than divisive.
money: Diversification may turn opposing assets or priorities into balance.
well_being: Hold differences without constant argument; the body benefits when vigilance decreases.
family: Difference within the family can become complementary rather than divisive.
personal_growth: Use opposition to understand difference instead of constructing an enemy.
caution: Difference turns hostile when each side insists on total victory.

title: Dui The Joyous
reflection: Meet the world with an open smile. Joy shared becomes a lake that mirrors the sky.
career: Improve morale through candid exchange, appreciation, and shared success.
love: Shared joy deepens through honest conversation, not forced cheerfulness.
outlook: Brighter conditions ahead, if honest conversation continues.
money: Shared enjoyment is affordable when limits are discussed honestly.
well_being: Conversation, laughter, and shared pleasure can restore lightness.
family: Shared laughter and honest conversation help restore emotional closeness.
personal_growth: Let honest joy soften defensiveness and deepen connection.
caution: Pleasure without truth becomes distraction.

title: Lü Treading
reflection: Walk as if on thin ice, aware and light. Caution is not fear; it is respect.
career: Move carefully where reputation, compliance, or trust can be damaged by one step.
love: Move carefully where one careless action could damage trust.
outlook: High stakes. One careful step matters more than speed.
money: Avoid high-risk commitments where one mistake could damage long- term security.
well_being: Move carefully when depleted; one avoidable excess may lengthen recovery.
family: Move carefully where one impulsive act could damage long-standing trust.
personal_growth: Develop careful awareness where consequences are larger than they appear.
caution: One careless step can outweigh many good intentions.

title: Tai Peace
reflection: Heaven and earth exchange breath. When high and low meet, all things prosper.
career: Open exchange between senior and junior levels can restore institutional flow.
love: Mutual exchange can restore peace when both people lower defensiveness.
outlook: A period of peace is possible through real exchange.
money: Improving exchange and cooperation can restore cash flow or access.
well_being: Balanced exchange between activity and rest improves resilience.
family: Open exchange between generations can create a more peaceful home.
personal_growth: Learn to exchange strength and vulnerability instead of defending one position.
caution: Peace can conceal unresolved interests if exchange is only superficial.

title: Da Xu The Taming Power Of The Great
reflection: Gather great force and hold it. Reserved strength moves mountains in time.
career: Hold power in reserve; demonstrate control by using less force, not more.
love: Strong desire needs restraint so neither person is overwhelmed.
outlook: Strong potential. Restraint decides whether it helps or harms.
money: Hold purchasing power in reserve and avoid displaying resources unnecessarily.
well_being: Strong energy should be contained and directed rather than spent all at once.
family: Use family authority to protect rather than dominate.
personal_growth: Hold power without needing to prove or display it.
caution: Stored power becomes arrogance when restraint is treated as weakness.

title: Xu Waiting
reflection: The nourishment is not yet ripe. Rest by the water; the right moment arrives.
career: Prepare patiently while timing, funding, or approval develops.
love: Wait without withdrawing affection; the right moment may still be forming.
outlook: Not yet. Prepare while the terms mature.
money: Wait for the terms, timing, or price to mature before committing.
well_being: Use the waiting period for preparation, sleep, and gentle maintenance.
family: Wait with steady care while a family decision or transition develops.
personal_growth: Use waiting as active preparation rather than disguised fear.
caution: Waiting becomes avoidance when preparation stops.

title: Xiao Xu The Taming Power Of The Small
reflection: A little restraint goes far. Small winds turn the great weather.
career: Use small restraints and detailed review to prevent a larger reversal.
love: Small acts of restraint protect the relationship from avoidable conflict.
outlook: A small delay protects the larger result.
money: A small spending limit now can prevent a much larger reversal.
well_being: Small boundaries around time, food, media, or work can protect broader balance.
family: Small rules around time, money, and responsibilities prevent larger conflict.
personal_growth: Discover how a small restraint can protect a larger freedom.
caution: Small restraint becomes pettiness when it serves only control.

title: Da Zhuang The Power Of The Great
reflection: Great strength is a trust, not a trophy. Use it and the ground stays firm.
career: Pair ambition with governance. Strength without restraint creates resistance.
love: Use strength to protect, not dominate; respect is the test of power.
outlook: Strong momentum, favorable under fair leadership.
money: Strong earning power is favorable when governed by restraint and accountability.
well_being: Strength is available, but recovery and self-command remain essential.
family: Strong family leadership requires fairness and self-restraint.
personal_growth: Let strength mature into justice, patience, and self- command.
caution: Power without self-command provokes resistance.

title: Da You Possession In Great Measure
reflection: Much is given; much is owed. Wealth kept closed becomes a cage.
career: Use wealth, access, or authority to benefit the whole rather than hoard advantage.
love: Share what you have—time, attention, security—without turning generosity into leverage.
outlook: Plenty is available. Circulation preserves it.
money: Resources are plentiful; protect value by sharing wisely and avoiding hoarding.
well_being: Abundant energy should circulate through movement, generosity, and meaningful use.
family: Use family resources to create security and opportunity for more than one person.
personal_growth: Learn to hold abundance without being possessed by it.
caution: Possession becomes a cage when generosity and circulation stop.

title: Guai Breakthrough
reflection: Name what must change, act decisively, and do not turn resolution into aggression.
career: Make the necessary break clearly, lawfully, and without personal vengeance.
love: Resolve the decisive issue openly, but do not confuse clarity with aggression.
outlook: The moment for a clear decision has arrived. Leave hostility out of it.
money: Resolve the financial break cleanly, document it, and do not turn it into retaliation.
well_being: Make a decisive break from the harmful pattern without harshness toward yourself.
family: Make the necessary family boundary clear, but do not turn it into revenge.
personal_growth: Practice ending what must end without cruelty or revenge.
caution: Do not let a necessary break become revenge.

title: Qian The Creative
reflection: Act from pure initiative. The dragon moves the heavens by simply being.
career: Initiate boldly, then sustain the work through disciplined follow-through.
love: Take sincere initiative and keep showing up after the first spark.
outlook: A strong beginning. Its promise depends on follow-through.
money: A new income stream is possible if initiative is matched by sustained execution.
well_being: Begin the restorative change with initiative, then support it through consistency.
family: Begin the family change directly, then sustain it through consistent example.
personal_growth: Begin with courage, then build the consistency that turns initiative into creation.
caution: Creative force fails when beginnings are abundant but follow-through is absent.
